title: When the city falls, the devil rises.

author: Marvel Entertainment
description:
This week, author Alex Segura joins us to chat about his new book, Enemy of My Enemy: A Daredevil Marvel Crime Novel. Plus, we gear up for the highly anticipated Season 2 premiere of Marvel Television’s Daredevil: Born Again by revisiting the highlights of Season 1. And we celebrate 25 years of Jessica Jones with a sneak peek at the upcoming comic book series, Alias: Red Band, with writer Sam Humphries. All time codes are approximate.

00:00 - Welcome Back!
01:44 - Author Alex Segura talks his new book Enemy of My Enemy: A Daredevil Marvel Crime Novel
